# Keycloak for the OAuth2 e2e specs in tests/e2e/auth/oauth2/.
# Start with `npm run test:keycloak:up`; the realm in realm-bruno.json is imported on boot.
services:
  keycloak:
    image: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.0
    command: start-dev --import-realm --http-port=8080
    environment:
      KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME: admin
      KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD: admin
      KC_HEALTH_ENABLED: "true"
    ports:
      - "8180:8080"
    volumes:
      - ./realm-bruno.json:/opt/keycloak/data/import/realm-bruno.json:ro
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          "CMD-SHELL",
          'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080 && printf "GET /realms/bruno/.well-known/openid-configuration HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n" >&3 && grep -q "200 OK" <&3',
        ]
      interval: 2s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 120s
